spec_atomic_units: 4-bit shift register
Right shift operation
Asynchronous reset (areset) resets register to zero
Synchronous load (load) loads register with data[3:0]
Synchronous enable (ena) shifts register right
q[3] becomes zero during right shift
q represents the contents of the shift register

implements combinational logic to prioritize areset, load, and then ena
If areset is asserted, q is forced to zero
If areset is not asserted and load is asserted, q is loaded with data
If neither areset nor load is asserted, and ena is asserted, q is shifted right
If none of areset, load, or ena are asserted, q retains its current value
The design uses an always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) block
Non-blocking assignments (<=) are used within the always block to update the register's value
